guards-inverses.evidence: Guards p in [0,1], odds>0 hold on all three references (evaluated). models.permitted_use: Use only as the simple-bet Kelly fraction (b*p-(1-p))/b with known win probability and positive net odds; a zero or negative result means bet nothing, and fractional-Kelly practice stays outside this record.
